Vendored rather than cloned: the release build includes Obfusk8/Instrumentation/.../Obfusk8Core.hpp,
and a build that needs the network is a build that breaks on a plane. See build.bat for the two
optimisation settings the two obfuscated translation units need (they differ, and both matter), and
the README section "Obfuscation (Obfusk8)" for what is and is not hidden.
